description: Reviewed exceptions for scripts/lint-claims.mjs. Each entry: file (repo-relative, forward slashes), text (substring of the offending source line), rule (rule id from lint-claims.mjs), reason (why this is acceptable, e.g. a verbatim NASA quotation with its source), reviewed (who/when). Add entries only after a person has read the line in context. Unused entries are reported as warnings.
